security_audit.summary: The skill is a LabArchives API integration package with expected network calls, local backup/configuration writes, and documented shell setup commands. The critical ransomware and C2 signals are false positives from prior audit text and documentation, but users should treat API credentials and notebook backups as sensitive data.

remediation.issue: The skill writes configuration and backup files that may contain sensitive research data or credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Keep default file permissions restrictive, document safe output directories, and remind users not to commit generated files.

remediation.issue: Examples include disabling SSL certificate verification for testing.
remediation.suggestion: Clearly mark verify=False examples as non-production only and recommend certificate installation for institutional proxies.

remediation.issue: The skill asks users to run local scripts and install a third-party LabArchives wrapper.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend reviewing scripts and dependency sources before execution, especially in regulated research environments.

content.value_statement: Research teams need reliable ways to move data between LabArchives and analysis tools. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured guidance for API setup, notebook backup, entries, attachments, and integrations.
actual_capabilities: Guides LabArchives API authentication with regional endpoint selection.
Explains how to list, back up, and manage accessible notebooks.
Provides scripts for creating entries, adding comments, and uploading attachments.
Documents integration patterns for Jupyter, REDCap, Protocols.io, and scientific tools.
Includes troubleshooting references for common API errors and credential issues.
limitations: Requires LabArchives Enterprise API access and valid user credentials.
Cannot bypass notebook permissions or institutional access controls.
Backup and upload actions may handle sensitive research data.
Some examples need local Python dependencies and manual configuration.

use_cases.title: Back up electronic lab notebooks
use_cases.description: Create structured LabArchives notebook exports for retention, review, or migration planning.

use_cases.title: Upload experiment outputs
use_cases.description: Attach analysis files, figures, and comments to existing LabArchives entries from automated workflows.

use_cases.title: Connect research platforms
use_cases.description: Plan integrations between LabArchives and tools such as Jupyter, REDCap, Protocols.io, and molecular biology software.

prompt_templates.title: Set up LabArchives API access
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure LabArchives API access for my regional endpoint. Explain what credentials I need and how to store them safely.

prompt_templates.title: Back up one notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the safest workflow to back up one LabArchives notebook with attachments. Include checks I should run after the export.

prompt_templates.title: Upload analysis results
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a LabArchives workflow that uploads a PDF report and CSV data file to an existing entry, then adds a metadata comment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a multi-tool research integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Jupyter to LabArchives integration that exports notebooks, records execution metadata, and preserves data governance controls.

output_examples.input: I need to back up a LabArchives notebook before a project audit.
output_examples.output: The skill can outline credential checks, notebook ID selection, export options, attachment handling, and post-backup verification steps.

output_examples.input: I want to upload experiment results from an analysis pipeline.
output_examples.output: The skill can describe how to identify the target notebook entry, upload approved files, add comments, and handle API errors.

output_examples.input: Our lab uses Jupyter and REDCap with LabArchives.
output_examples.output: The skill can compare integration patterns and recommend a workflow that respects authentication, permissions, and data sensitivity.

best_practices: Use least-privilege API credentials and rotate them on an institutional schedule.
Verify notebook permissions and data classification before uploading or exporting content.
Store generated config files and backups outside version control with restrictive permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste production credentials into prompts, tickets, or shared documents.
Do not disable SSL verification except in controlled testing environments.
Do not bulk export notebooks without confirming consent, retention rules, and access scope.

faq.question: Does this skill require a LabArchives account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need LabArchives Enterprise API access and credentials from your institution or administrator.

faq.question: Can it access notebooks I cannot normally view?
faq.answer: No. It works within the permissions of the authenticated LabArchives user and API credentials.

faq.question: Does it store my credentials?
faq.answer: The skill includes scripts that can write local configuration files. Store those files securely and keep them out of version control.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What integrations are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover workflows for Jupyter, REDCap, Protocols.io, GraphPad Prism, SnapGene, Geneious, and related scientific tools.

faq.question: Is it safe for regulated research data?
faq.answer: Use institutional review before production use. Confirm data handling, backup storage, audit logging, and retention requirements.
